links.passage: In addition, on-demand irrigation networks can result in inefficient water use if farmers do not perform adequate irrigation scheduling, particularly when they need the help of the irrigation advisory services (Ortega, De Juan, & Tarjuelo, 2005).
reference_entries: Ortega, J. F., De Juan, J. A., & Tarjuelo, J. M. (2005). Improving water management: the irrigation advisory service of Castilla-La Mancha (Spain). Agricultural Water Management, 77, 37e58.

links.passage: The investment cost of on-demand networks is usually higher, mostly because water supply is guaranteed during peak periods (Calejo, Lamaddalena, Teixeira, & Pereira, 2008; Khadra & Lamaddalena, 2006; Lamaddalena and Sagargoy, 2000; Planells, Carrión, Ortega, Moreno, & Tarjuelo, 2005; Planells, Tarjuelo, Ortega, & Casanova, 2001; Moreno et al. 2007a; Daccache, Lamaddalena, & Fratino, 2010).
